quick-match.title: Quick Match
quick-match.summary: Fast one-off match against a bot opponent close to your team strength. Covers opponent selection, rewards, stars and the quick-match leaderboard.

league-match.title: League Match
league-match.summary: How a league match works from ready-up and toss through ball-by-ball play (spinner, play styles, probability meter) to match tabs, autoplay and the match room.

match-preparation.title: Match Preparation and Focus Boost
match-preparation.summary: Six preparation tasks before a league match, each worth +0.25 Focus Boost (max +1.5) applied to every player for that match, plus the focus level names.

playing-xi.title: Playing XI
playing-xi.summary: Building and managing your Playing XI: Auto Build, Reserve, Tactical Balance (12 criteria), batting order zones, bowling order, formation, batting strategy, autoplay, captain, Super Over squad and team rules.

field-setting.title: Field Setting
field-setting.summary: Default fielding presets for Powerplay (overs 1-3) and Normal Play (overs 4-10): zones, 18 presets, quality ratings and best preset by bowler and batter matchup.

stadiums.title: Stadiums and Pitches
stadiums.summary: The five pitch types (Flat, Green, Dusty, Slow, Bouncy), how hidden pitch boosts of -2 to +3 work and who each pitch favours.

signing-market.title: Signing Market
signing-market.summary: How to sign free agents: recommended picks, filters, Potential Playing XI, Scout, offers and price, decision windows, how players decide, results, squad delivery, History and pool quotas.
